item.title: GTA 6 Is Already Breaking Twitch Records
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 is already rewriting streaming history. Rockstar Games' highly anticipated sequel has attracted 3.29 million concurrent viewers on Twitch, breaking the platform's previous record for a video game launch as its global rollout continues.

item.title: GTA 6 Won’t Be Getting a Future Performance Mode, Even on PS5 Pro
item.description: In a rough turn of events for frame rate diehards, it seems Grand Theft Auto 6 won’t get a patch that boosts its frame rate at the expense of graphical fidelity. Speaking with Kotaku , Rockstar confirmed the game will not receive a performance mode on modern consoles, even on the beefier PlayStation 5 Pro.

item.title: GTA 6's Hidden Drug System Is Surprisingly Deep
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 might be known as a crime simulator, but Rockstar's open-world game is t ruly a sandbox full of systems . Some of these features, like the game's vast NPC generation system , are immediately apparent when you play . Others, like GTA 6 's drug system, are borderline invisible — they're never mentioned in the game, and may be impossible to track .

item.title: New Friday the 13th Movie Reveals All-New Jason, Dutton Ranch Star for Cast
item.description: Just last week, Horror, Inc. announced that Jason Voorhees would be returning in a new Friday the 13th movie . The initial announcement for the lucky 13th entry in the franchise revealed that series veteran Steve Miner would be returning to direct the horror feature. Now we have a lot more details about what to expect when Jason returns next year, with the release date and cast details finally revealed .

item.title: Resident Evil's Pedestrian monster wasn't actually a practical effect
item.description: Despite reports otherwise, the viral motion test for Resident Evil's Pedestrian didn't make it into the movie, says Weta VFX Supervisor Kevin Smith. But the effect was convincing!

item.title: As GTA 6 Breaks Records, Rockstar Devs Call for Union Recognition
item.description: Grand Theft Auto 6 will almost certainly set sales records when it launches tomorrow, Nov. 19. However, despite the windfall for Rockstar Games, many of the studio’s employees remain worried about their jobs. In an opinion piece from The Guardian , Rockstar animation programmer Nestor Uriarte outlined the benefits of unionization as developers at the studio await the results of an ongoing union vote. 1,600 staff in the U.K. have until Nov. 26 to cast their ballots.

item.title: GTA 6 Players Have Already Discovered the Most Evil Crime in the Game
item.description: The long-awaited Grand Theft Auto 6 doesn't technically come out until midnight local time on Nov. 19 , but plenty of eager gamers are taking advantage of the New Zealand trick to play the game early. Even though GTA 6 reviews only dropped a few hours ago, players are already getting up to plenty of hijinks in Leonida. Just like in Red Dead Redemption 2 , it seems like there are plenty of ways for a sincere oopsie or button fumble to spiral out of control pretty fast.

item.title: Game Awards 2026: All Game of the Year Nominees and Predictions
item.description: At this point, we have a good idea of what games will be favored by The Game Awards' voting body : A high Metacritic rating (preferably over 90) is a must; role-playing games and action-adventures are strongly favored, as are games with strong narrative elements; indie and multiplayer games struggle harder for recognition than AAA single-player adventures. We used these metrics to correctly predict last year's winner, Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 , and the 2024 winner, Astro Bot . In 2025, we also predicted all six GOTY nominees and correctly called 20 other categories.

item.title: Magic: the Gathering Is Officially Reprinting an Iconic $42 Artifact with Perfect Dune Art
item.description: That scary box that the Bene Gesserit forced Paul Atreides to put his hand into is about to make your Magic: The Gathering artifacts a lot harder to destroy. Pain Box appears in Magic 's new Dune -themed Secret Lair as a new reprint of Darksteel Forge, a powerful $42 card that gives all of your artifacts indestructible. That makes it one of the biggest draws of the "My Arrakis, My Superdrop" Secret Lair revealed Nov. 18, but the Superdrop is also chock-full of unique legendary creatures vying for a spot as your favorite new Commander.
